findings.description: Submitting the add/edit expense form with invalid data (e.g. negative amount or empty title, bypassing browser validation) returns a bare 400 page with an empty form: no error message says what was wrong, and everything the user typed is discarded. The same happens on the edit form.
repro: Enter title 'Err', amount -3 (or POST with an empty title)
Page reloads as an empty form with HTTP 400 and no error text; values are lost

findings.description: Delete removes the expense immediately with no confirmation, and gives no feedback afterwards (add shows 'Expense saved', edit shows 'Expense updated', delete shows nothing). Deleting a non-existent id also silently redirects as if it succeeded instead of returning 404.
repro: Row vanishes with no confirmation and no status message

findings.description: Amount validation is too loose: zero-amount expenses and absurd values (e.g. 99999999999) are accepted and inflate the total (to $100000000409.09), with no upper bound.
repro: Row is saved and Total shows $100000000409.09

notes: Totals (all, per category), permissions (viewer 403 on create/edit/delete, anon redirected to login), filtering, login errors, XSS escaping all behaved correctly. No JS in app. I added and deleted test rows as editor.

cost.notes: estimate from 29674 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0059-$0.0712
